messages:
sophie: FYI deploy-bot blocked the release for auth-svc during canary promote. Root cause looks like missing image layer in registry.
sophie: Error snippet from job: `pull image auth-svc:2026-03-20-rc5 -> blob unknown to registry`

deploy-bot: job_id=db-8021 service=auth-svc env=canary status=FAILED reason=registry-blob-missing

kai: omg. I saw a few 5xxs from our registry earlier. Ops was doing GC job around 02:00 UTC.

ops-ci: We did run a manual GC to free up space in eu-west. GC reported orphaned blob cleanup and completed. I'm investigating whether we cleaned a referenced blob by mistake.

rachel: If the blob is gone, pipeline may fallback to `:latest` in some codepaths which triggers admission policy rejects. We should avoid that.

mike: Options: 1) repush the missing image layers and re-run canary, 2) rollpin to previous pinned image (2026-03-17-hotfix.2), 3) cancel change window and delay. I'm leaning to repush if we have the build artifacts.

kai: Do we have the build cache/artifact for that tag? CI artifacts show `auth-svc:2026-03-20-rc5` build finished but registry push failed intermittently. The image digest exists in CI storage.

sophie: Proposal: repush the image from CI storage -> registry (ops to confirm), then trigger deploybot retry. If repush can't be done quickly, fallback to rollpin to 2026-03-17-hotfix.2 and continue. Keep change window intact.

ops-ci: I'll try a repush now from CI artifact storage (artifact id=ci-4456). ETA ~12m. I'll post logs.

deploy-bot: queued retry job id=db-8022 for service=auth-svc env=canary triggered_by=sophie

ops-ci: repush failed first attempt: multipart upload abort on part 3 -> 5xx. Trying a second push to alternate registry node.

mike: If repush fails, prepare rollpin PR. Who will open it?

rachel: I can open rollpin branch: rollpin/auth-svc-to-2026-03-17-hotfix.2 and attach the release note blurb.

ops-ci: second repush succeeded. Pushed image `auth-svc:2026-03-20-rc5` to eu-west-registry node-02. Digest: sha256:deadbeef...

deploy-bot: retry job db-8022 started, pulling image sha256:deadbeef...

deploy-bot: retry job db-8022 result=SUCCEEDED canary=GREEN

release-bot: Change window still open. Auto-appending release note: "Temporary registry GC removed unreferenced blob causing auth-svc push to fail; repushed from CI artifacts and retried canary. No user-facing impact observed."

sophie: Great work. Let's add a short postmortem note action: don't run aggressive GC during change windows and add a pre-GC safety check for referenced blobs.
kai: filing follow-up task in infra backlog now.
mike: Closing thread after release notes merge. :white_check_mark:
